company_type: Small business software company (synthetic phase-planning fixture)
goal: Deliver a customer-support portal pilot with agreed request fields and acceptance criteria, a working API, a staging environment, completed integration and testing, and documented pilot support and rollback procedures. Product supplies the field contract to Engineering; Engineering supplies the build to Operations; Operations returns test findings for Engineering to resolve. Work only with synthetic data. Leaders must choose the business phases and durations from this goal, the available staff, and the total workdays.
